favourite.heading: Why Michigan can pull away
bullets: Michigan is the better football team by 19.4 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 86% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+19.4 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 6.9 points to Michigan (+6.9 pts).
Playing at Michigan is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Michigan by 2.7 points: ball control vs front disruption (+2.7 pts).

underdog.heading: Why UTEP can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 +9.1 to p90 +54.1 for Michigan, so a projection of +33.1 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
60% of the model’s own input contract was empty for this game — no starter, injury or per-player talent context reached it, so the number leans on team strength more than it should.
